item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Edward Jiang, Timothy Heightman, Marcin Płodzień
arXiv:2611.14006v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a novel framework to learn a representation of quantum circuits based on the phase space formulation of many-body systems. Given that N-qubit states can be represented as probability distributions on a smooth 2N-dimensional manifold, we show how unitary gates can be parameterized as normalizing flows between these distributions, opening a new avenue for quantum circuit simulation using generative models. We evaluate our method on three common families of quantum circuits, and show that its accuracy exceeds that of current state-of-the-art neural network methods for large system sizes.

arXiv:2611.13071v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: A tripartite pure state is local-unitary equivalent to a stabilizer state if and only if its marginal, reflected, and negativity spectra (up to signs) are flat. These conditions are quantified using anti-flatness, giving a diagnostic of tripartite nonlocal magic that is computable and experimentally measurable using randomized measurements. In non-abelian quantum doubles, it appears only when the triple points of the tripartition lie on plaquettes. In random tensor networks, it appears exactly when the entanglement wedge of two boundary regions connects.

item.title: 无池、残差触发的变分虚时间演化拟设增长：固定算符顺序何时优于自适应筛选
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Yu-Hao Chen, Renata Wong
本文研究了一种用于变分虚时间演化（VITE）的无算符池替代方案，其中层级由哈密顿量的嵌套对易子预先固定，并根据相对McLachlan残差动态添加新层。在五个非可积系统上的测试表明，这种动态VITE方法以显著更少的电路实现了10⁻⁴的相对误差，优于多种自适应变体。研究发现，这种优势在可积性被破坏时更为明显，因为此时自适应筛选成本较高。

item.title: PINNverse 遇上 Jordan-Wigner：学习长自旋链的哈密顿量
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Gubio G De Lima
逆物理信息神经网络（PINNverse）在学习量子哈密顿量参数时，其输出随量子比特数N呈指数增长。本文展示了对于具有最近邻交换相互作用的自旋链，Jordan-Wigner变换可以消除这种指数成本，将网络输出需求降至N²。通过合成数据，该网络成功学习了多达50个量子比特链的哈密顿量参数，耦合精度优于0.1%。

item.title: 通过云服务对量子处理器中GHZ态生成进行跨平台基准测试
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Sergio Hernández, Unai Aseguinolaza, David Aguirre, Marta Gili, Joseba Hernández, Guillermo Valverde, Uxue Ballarin Manso, Uxue Auzmendi, Iker Pastor, Pablo García Bringas, Ane Blázquez García, Rubén Peña, Mikel Sanz
量子计算硬件平台多样化，基准测试对于评估其性能至关重要。本研究通过云服务对来自五个供应商的九个商用量子处理器进行了跨平台基准测试，涵盖超导和离子阱技术。实验在无错误缓解的默认编译设置下，评估了Greenberger-Horne-Zeilinger (GHZ) 态的保真度，结果揭示了不同平台在生成GHZ态性能上存在显著差异。

item.title: 量子同步的相干-耗散交叉
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Li Liu, Niu Wang, Xun-Wei Xu, Jie-Qiao Liao, Hui Jing, Le-Man Kuang, Changliang Ren
开放系统中的量子同步可源于相干相互作用和集体耗散，但两者的相互作用机制尚不明确。本文提出了一个通用框架，揭示了相干交换和集体耗散两种同步通道，并给出了连接耗散和相干主导区域的解析描述。研究表明，同步由相干耦合、耗散和储层诱导涨落的共同平衡决定，且对共享输出的持续监测可显著增强条件同步。
